steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Cost. Scrap and rework are priced by line and cause, then totalled.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 total does not match its records

findings.title: Total does not match its records
findings.fix: Recompute the total from the records

findings.title: Unit cost with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the unit cost

outcome.notChecked: Whether the scrap could have been avoided.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] total.csv:12  Total does not match its records.
       Fix: Recompute the total from the records.
[medium] scrap-line-a.csv:19  Record with no cause code.
       Fix: Code the record.
[low] unit-cost.md:26  Unit cost with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the unit cost.
Not checked: Whether the scrap could have been avoided.
pros: Checks a record with no cause code, a unit cost with no source, and a total that does not match its records.
cons: Not checked: Whether the scrap could have been avoided.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-scrap-rework-cost skill on the records for this review.
